en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad Al Qalanasy, from Ali Bin Al Husayn Bin Amro, from Ali Bin Mahziyar who said,

‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, ‘If there was an occurrence (of death), and I seek Refuge with Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, so to whom?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> Covenant is to the eldest of my<sup>asws</sup> sons’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Qalanisi from Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn ‘Amr from Ali ibn Mahziyar who has said the following.

“Once I said abu al-Hassan (a.s.), “If something will happen-I seek refuge before Allah – to who then will go (Leadership with Divine Authority)?” He said, “My covenant (directive will) is for the eldest of my sons.”
